tasks.instruction: Uzupelnij kazde zdanie slowem utworzonym od wyrazu podanego wielkimi literami. Wymagana jest pelna poprawnosc ortograficzna i gramatyczna.

items.sentence: Employers have recently complained that they can't find reliable __________.
She is __________ for the job as she cannot swim, which is absolutely essential to become a lifeguard.
I didn't pass my final exam although I had studied so hard. The only thing I felt was deep __________.
My new mobile is much bigger than the previous one which makes it __________. I can't put it in any of my pockets.
Mobile phones nowadays have __________ capabilities, such as sending and receiving e-mails or using instant messaging.
King Arthur was considered to be an exceptionally __________ leader, who feared nobody.
It is said that __________ killed the cat. Don't be too nosy.
Airlines shouldn't employ such young and __________ people for pilot positions. It is simply irresponsible.
He said he loved me and looked at me in __________.
I came back home after 10 years of absence. All my friends prepared for me a surprise party full of __________ and affection.
